metaTitle: Housecall Pro Marketing Agency: What We Add to HCP
metaDescription: What a Housecall Pro marketing agency adds on top of HCP: attribution to booked jobs, Google and Meta ads, SEO, and follow-up built around your HCP data.

hero.subhead: Housecall Pro's automated marketing works on customers already in your system. ASP runs the ads and SEO that bring new ones in, and ties each booked job back to its source.
points: Attribution from first click to HCP job
Google Ads, Meta, LSA and SEO
HCP's CSR AI configured for you

why.heading: What HCP covers and where ASP starts
why.intro: Housecall Pro calls its built-in outreach automated marketing, and it is aimed at repeat business and referrals. Finding new homeowners and proving which ad paid is the work ASP adds.

cards.title: HCP's automated marketing
cards.body: Postcards, email marketing, job reminders and thank-you emails, plus Automated Text Campaigns that reach up to 10 customers a day who are due for follow-up.

cards.title: Lead Source needs real data
cards.body: HCP's Lead Source field records where a customer found you. ASP's call tracking and form fields fill it from data instead of guesswork.

cards.title: No Google Ads integration listed
cards.body: As of October 2026, HCP's integrations page lists no native Google Ads or Google Analytics integration. ASP sends booked revenue back to Google Ads as offline conversions.

services.heading: What ASP sets up on top of Housecall Pro
services.intro: Each piece connects to HCP, so the job record, the revenue and the marketing source sit in one place.

cards.title: Job attribution
cards.body: Click IDs captured on forms and tracked calls are stored on the HCP customer record, then returned to Google with the revenue after the job closes.

cards.title: Google and Meta ads
cards.body: Google Ads and Meta campaigns bring in new homeowners, with bidding that follows booked jobs instead of raw leads.

cards.title: Local Services Ads management
cards.body: HCP connects Local Services Ads bookings to Job Inbox. ASP manages the LSA account itself, including the reviews and response time it ranks on.

cards.title: SEO and Business Profile
cards.body: Service pages, content and technical fixes, plus Business Profile management, so homeowners find you before they reach your booking page.

cards.title: CSR AI setup
cards.body: We configure the voice, script, escalation rules and booking calendar for HCP's CSR AI so it sounds like your business.

cards.title: Follow-up sequences
cards.body: Quote-to-close sequences, maintenance reminders and win-back campaigns, mapped to your sales process and built on HCP's job events.

process.heading: How a Housecall Pro setup runs

steps.title: Growth Audit
steps.body: We map your CRM, ad accounts, attribution, follow-up and reporting to find where revenue is leaking.

steps.title: HCP configuration
steps.body: New accounts get set up under the Housecall Pro affiliate program. Existing accounts get audited, and we fix what's misaligned.

steps.title: One tool at a time
steps.body: CSR AI, attribution and follow-up go live one at a time, and each one is confirmed working before the next.

steps.title: Monthly revenue review
steps.body: Ad spend sits next to booked revenue from HCP, reported as cost per booked job.

pricing.heading: Where HCP setup fits in the packages
pricing.subhead: Housecall Pro attribution setup is included in Foundation. HCP AI onboarding, covering CSR AI, dispatch and reporting, comes with Growth along with paid media management.

faqs.question: Does Housecall Pro do marketing for you?
faqs.answer: It automates part of it. HCP's automated marketing sends postcards, email campaigns, job reminders and follow-ups, and its review tools request reviews after each job or payment. Running Google Ads, Meta ads and SEO is the work an agency adds.

faqs.question: Can Housecall Pro track which ad produced a job?
faqs.answer: HCP's Lead Source field records where a customer found you, and its reports filter by lead source. Filling that field automatically and sending booked revenue back to Google Ads takes call tracking, form tracking and offline conversion setup.

faqs.question: Does Housecall Pro work with Local Services Ads?
faqs.answer: Yes. HCP integrates with Google Local Services Ads and Reserve with Google, and Google bookings land in one Google channel in Job Inbox. You need your own Local Services Ads account to connect it, and ASP can manage that account.

faqs.question: Do I get a discount on Housecall Pro through ASP?
faqs.answer: Discounts for new HCP accounts only. Full terms are shared during your growth audit. If you already use HCP, we audit your setup and fix what's misaligned instead.

faqs.question: Is ASP part of Housecall Pro?
faqs.answer: No. ASP is a separate marketing agency and a Housecall Pro Affiliate. Housecall Pro makes the software, and the setup and marketing work on this page is ASP's, not Housecall Pro's.

cta.heading: Get more out of Housecall Pro
cta.body: Talk to us about your HCP setup. We'll map your stack, show where revenue is leaking, and set the order for fixing it.
